_readme: Copy to profile/achievements.json (jobagent init does this) and make it yours.
This is your metrics & achievements bank — quantified wins, awards, projects,
and certifications that may not all fit on the resume. The fit-scorer uses it
as evidence when judging fit; the tailor agent pulls from it to strengthen
bullets and cover letters. Everything here MUST be true and defensible in an
interview — it is covered by the same no-fabrication rule as the resume.
Add as much as you can: concrete numbers beat adjectives every time.
